Can you confirm whether you can provide the following by COB 2026-03-25? If any of the items are not available, please flag and suggest an alternate artifact and ETA.

Requested items:

Also: auditor prefers artifacts to be bundled as PDFs or CSVs and stable links (Drive/Doc store). If you need more time, let me know specific items and timelines.

Thanks — below are the artifacts I'm attaching and a short explanation for each item. If the auditor needs raw logs we can pull more granular exports; the attached samples are redacted for customer privacy.

Attachments included:
- Redwood_Data_Retention_Policy_v2.pdf (last updated 2026-02-10)
- Data_Deletion_Playbook.docx (runbook: soft-delete -> TTL job -> hard-delete verification)
- s3_lifecycle_policy.json (bucket policies; shows expiry by prefix and transition rules)
- retention_matrix.csv (data class mapping; includes legal basis column)

Quick answers to Olivia's clarifications:
- Proof of deletion: Our standard evidence is the TTL job run log + S3 object expiration event with object key patterns. For the sample customer we have deletion job id: job-20260310-87 (see redacted log). Auditor usually accepts the job run record + storage event.
- Residency controls: Tenant attributes include "region" tag at account creation time; for Dedicated/Private customers we additionally enforce VPC region selection and subnet constraints. Evidence: account metadata export + routing table snapshots (we can provide).
- Snapshots/backups: Backups are encrypted and have retention aligned to the retention matrix; there is a separate deletion workflow for snapshot deletion that references the same TTL engine.
- Periodic audits: Security runs quarterly retention audits; exceptions require Manager approval and are tracked in SUP- tickets.

Related artifacts live in the Drive bundle: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/finbank/soc2/evidence-collection
